_about: Assumptions tools/balance_sim.py needs that are not game tuning: how fast people work, how they choose, and the thresholds the checks hold. The game never reads this file. Every entry has a source: 'guess' (nobody has measured it yet), a doc, a game file it mirrors by hand, or 'calibrated <date>' once balance:G measures it. A value 'const:Script.NAME.key' is read from the game's scripts; 'model:name' is another entry here. See docs/BALANCE.md.

leaf_rate_yard_per_min.source: guess, by crew size 1..4: a regular full yard's leaves per wall-clock minute with the job's one rake, bags and hauling (utilization already in); was [0.055, 0.09, 0.11, 0.12], matching docs/FUN.md's 6 to 12 minute jobs for 2 to 4 people. Calibrated 2026-11-02 by tools/rake_pace.gd for the windrow rule (rakefeel:field): a job with bagging and hauling at a walking pace takes 1.27x as long as with 0.4.7's 3.2 m stroke (785 s -> 995 s), so the rake's part of each rate (rake_share) is x0.79 and the rest is unchanged.

leafable_share.source: guess: the share of the 40 m pad (Constants.PAD_HALF) that grows leaves, after the house, the swept driveway and the tool corner (levels/lots/lot_generator.gd _shape_leaves).

rake_share.source: guess, by crew size: the share of the crew's leaf rate that is the one rake, so the rake tune-up (Campaign.rake_multiplier, only for the player holding it) speeds only that part.

blower_bonus.source: guess, by crew size: leaf rate with a leaf blower in the crew (it shoves leaves into piles).

blower_use_share.source: guess: share of the leaf minutes a blower runs when the crew owns one (noise for heat).

wheelbarrow_bonus.source: guess: leaf rate with the upgraded wheelbarrow (8 bags a trip instead of 4).

hand_leaf_rate.source: guess: a hired hand's leaf rate per unit of skill, in regular yards per minute. npcs/crew_hand.gd rakes, bags and hauls, so a hand at full skill is close to a solo player's 0.055.

bag_efficiency.source: guess: the share of the cleaned leaves' dollar value that reaches Chefty in bags (the rest is blown off the pad, mowed into confetti, or left in half piles).

bag_value_avg.source: guess from the gap spec: job_test bags are $4 to $9, a human pile tops out near $17. Chefty's cap is Constants.TRUCK_BAG_CAPACITY times this.

clean_target.source: guess: crews stop raking a little past Constants.XP_LEAVES_CLEAN_AT.

clean_noise.source: guess: spread (sd) of the cleaned fraction around the target.

task_done_target.source: guess: how much of a doable task a crew finishes.

task_person_minutes.source: guess: focused minutes of one person per task on a regular yard, divided by utilization for the wall clock (mow_lawn 2.0 makes the mower run about 150 s, the gap spec's measure).

task_size_scale.source: guess: task minutes on a small, regular and big yard.

utilization.source: core/balance.gd BAL-06; applied to task minutes (the leaf rates are already wall-clock).

noise_by_task.source: guess: which tool a task runs (Constants.HEAT_NOISE_PER_SECOND keys) and for what share of the task's time.

job_overhead_minutes.source: guess: per job, the rides (net/components/ride.gd 8 s each way), unloading, the homeowner's reaction and grabbing the cash.

arrive_to_work_minutes.source: guess: from the homeowner's clock starting (Campaign.start_job_clock) to work starting, plus walking to talk at the end. Counts against patience.

store_minutes_per_job.source: guess: the job board, shopping and regrouping at Homie Depot before each job.

day_overhead_minutes.source: guess: per day, the summary card, the phone and walking to the cots.

travel_minutes_by_hood.source: guess, by neighborhood index, on top of job_overhead_minutes: the legacy map rides are fixed (already in the overhead); the drivable town's are guesses until TownMap lands (critic.md, driving). Constants.TOWN_MAP_DEFAULT picks the row.

raid.source: guess: work lost to the warning and chase (Constants.RUN_WARNING_SECONDS + up to RUN_CHASE_SECONDS), each player's chance of being caught, and a caught player's time away (Border Return, BORDER_CROSSING_SECONDS plus the van).

water.source: guess: how often a hose task hooks up to the house's spigot (Constants.SPIGOT_HOOKUP_FEE + SPIGOT_FEE_PER_SECOND), and for how long.

bills.source: guess: the chance a job breaks something billable (a hose $25, a gnome $15, a foot $40 or $120) and the average bill.

homeowner_inline.source: mirrors npcs/homeowner.gd _judge by hand: the 'some days people are just in a mood' rolls are still inline there, not in constants.gd.

town_inline.source: mirrors net/town/town.gd by hand: the luck in _ask_for_jobs, the word_of_mouth step in _maybe_refer, and _make_house's likes_from are still inline there.

pick_policy.source: guess: the crew takes the offer with the best expected pay per minute (rides included).

rush_policy.source: guess: when a job would outlast the homeowner's patience, the crew either finishes (and gets 'slow') or wraps up at the patience line with less done, whichever pays more per minute.

buy_policy.source: guess: crew-shared things are bought by the richest player as soon as they can pay and keep a day of wages; per_player things by each player; 'endless' and 'cosmetic' wants wait until the buyer also keeps endless_buffer_days of their income.

hire_policy.source: guess: hire into a free slot once the signing fee is at most this many days of per-player net income and the richest player can pay it and keep this many days of the whole payroll.

start_job_cutoff_hour.source: levels/world.gd can_depart: no new job once the clock stops.

wait_for_texts.source: guess: with no requests before bedtime (Constants.SLEEP_FROM_HOUR) the crew waits for the next daytime text instead of idling to bed.

human_vs_bot.source: placeholder for balance:G (calibration from soak runs).

seeds.source: gap spec: 40 seeds keeps a full --check under 15 s.

endless_days.source: gap spec: the endless-loop check looks at 20 days past The Lawnfather.

targets.source: gap-specs/balance.json tests and player_design: the thresholds of the --check checks and what --propose aims for.
